title: حزب النصر
fullTitleEn: The Litany of Victory of Imām al-Ḥaddād
author: الإمام عبد الله بن علوي الحداد
source: مأخوذ من «الخلاصة» للحبيب عمر بن حفيظ، والترجمة الإنجليزية من طبعة أشنتار (٢٠١٣)
sourceEn: From “Al-Khulāṣah – The Cream of Remembrance” (Ashnataar Publications, 2nd ed. 2013), Arabic and English translation; minor corrections to the translation where it departs from the Arabic.

chapters.title: الذكر والفتح
chapters.titleEn: The dhikr and the verses of victory

bayts.s: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ.
t: There is no god, but Allāh, the King, the Manifest Truth.

bayts.s: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
t: In the Name of Allāh, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

bayts.s: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا
t: Verily, We have given you (O Muḥammad) a clear (manifest) victory.

bayts.s: لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
t: That Allāh may forgive you your sins of the past and the future and complete His Favour on you and guide you on the Straight Path.

bayts.s: وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
t: So that Allāh might bestow on you His Mighty Help. [Sūrah Al-Fatḥ (48), Verses 1-3]

bayts.s: وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا
t: And he (Moses) was honourable in the sight of Allāh. [Sūrah Al-Aḥzāb (33), Verse 69]

bayts.s: وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
t: (Jesus will be held in honour) in this world and in the Hereafter, and he will be one of those who are granted nearness to Allāh. [Sūrah Āli ʿImrān (3), Verse 45]

bayts.s: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
t: (Says Abraham): “I have turned my face towards Him Who has created the Heavens and the earth.” [Sūrah Al-Anʿām (6), Verse 79]

bayts.s: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
t: In the Name of Allāh, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

bayts.s: نَصْرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ
t: … help from Allāh (against your enemies) and an imminent victory;

bayts.s: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
t: and give glad tidings (O Muḥammad) to the believers. [Sūrah Al-Ṣaff (61), Verse 13]

bayts.s: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا أَنْصَارَ اللَّهِ
t: O you who believe, be Allāh’s Helpers

bayts.s: كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
t: as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples: “Who will be my helpers (in the work of) Allāh?”

bayts.s: قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنْصَارُ اللَّهِ
t: The disciples said: “We are Allāh’s helpers...” [Sūrah Al-Ṣaff (61), Verse 14]

bayts.s: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
t: Allāh! There is no deity but Him; the Ever-Living, the Self Subsisting, the Eternal One.

bayts.s: لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
t: Neither slumber nor sleep can overtake Him.

bayts.s: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
t: To Him belongs whatsoever is in the Heavens and whatsoever is on the earth.

bayts.s: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
t: Who is there that can intercede in His Presence, except by His permission?

bayts.s: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
t: He knows what will happen to them (His creatures) in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter;

bayts.s: وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ
t: nor shall they comprehend anything at all of His Knowledge except as He Wills.

bayts.s: وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
t: His Throne extends over the Heavens and the earth,

bayts.s: وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
t: and guarding and preserving it, does not exhaust Him, for He is the Exalted, the All-Mighty. [Sūrah Al-Baqarah (2), Verse 255]

bayts.s: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
t: In the Name of Allāh, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

bayts.s: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ
t: Had We sent down this Qur’ān on a mountain, you would have certainly seen it humbling itself and splitting asunder for its fear of Allāh.

bayts.s: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
t: We relate these parables to men so that they may reflect.

bayts.s: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ
t: He is Allāh: there is no other god but Him. The All-Knower of the Unseen and the seen. He is the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

bayts.s: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
t: He is Allāh, there is no other god, but Him; the King, the Most Pure, the Source of Peace (and Perfection), the Giver of Security, the Protector, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great; Glory be to Allāh. (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.

bayts.s: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
t: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner. To Him belongs the Most Beautiful Names. Everything in the Heavens and the earth glorify Him. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. [Sūrah Al-Ḥashr (59), Verses 21-24]

bayts.s: أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي بِاللَّهِ تَعَالَى مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنَيْنِ، وَيُبْصِرُ بِعَيْنَيْنِ،
t: I seek refuge for myself with Allāh, the Most High, from whatever hears with two ears, beholds with two eyes,

bayts.s: وَيَمْشِي بِرِجْلَيْنِ، وَيَبْطِشُ بِيَدَيْنِ، وَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِشَفَتَيْنِ؛
t: walks with two legs, touches with two hands, speaks with two lips.

bayts.s: حَصَّنْتُ نَفْسِي بِاللَّهِ الْخَالِقِ الْأَكْبَرِ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ؛ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ؛
t: I fortify myself with Allāh, the Great Creator, from evils that I fear or I am wary of, from humans and jinn that may appear (to harm me).

bayts.s: عَزَّ جَارُهُ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ وَتَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُهُ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ.
t: Honoured is the one who is closest to Him; Exalted is His Praise; sacred are His Names, and there is no god, save Him. O Allāh! I (restrain) my enemies by placing You against their necks, and I seek refuge in You from their evils, their ploys, their cunningness, and their deceit. Extinguish the fire of whomsoever intends animosity towards me from among the jinn and humans.

bayts.s: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِ أَعْدَائِي،
t: O Allāh! I place You against the necks of my enemies,

bayts.s: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ وَتَحَيُّلِهِمْ وَمَكْرِهِمْ وَمَكَائِدِهِمْ؛
t: and I seek refuge in You from their evils, their ploys, their cunningness, and their deceit.

bayts.s: أَطْفِئْ نَارَ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِيَ عَدَاوَةً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ.
t: Extinguish the fire of whomsoever intends animosity towards me from among the jinn and humans.

bayts.s: يَا حَافِظُ يَا حَفِيظُ، يَا كَافِي يَا مُحِيطُ؛
t: O the Preserver, O the Protector, O the Self-Sufficient, O the All-Embracing,

bayts.s: سُبْحَانَكَ يَا رَبِّ؛ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنُكَ وَأَعَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ.
t: Glory be to You, my Lord; how sublime is Your Rank, and how great is Your Honour!

bayts.s: تَحَصَّنْتُ بِاللَّهِ، وَبِأَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَبِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَمَلَائِكَةِ اللَّهِ،
t: I fortify myself with Allāh, and with the Names of Allāh, and with the Verses of Allāh, and with the Angels of Allāh,

bayts.s: وَأَنْبِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَرُسُلِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ؛
t: and with the Prophets of Allāh, and with the Messengers of Allāh, and with the righteous among the bondsmen of Allāh.

bayts.s: حَصَّنْتُ نَفْسِي بِ(لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ).
t: I fortify myself with: there is no god, but Allāh, and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and may the Blessings and Peace of Allāh be upon him and his family.

bayts.s: اللَّهُمَّ احْرُسْنِي بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِي لَا تَنَامُ، وَاكْنُفْنِي بِكَنَفِكَ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ،
t: O Allāh! Guard me with Your Eye that never sleeps, and protect me in Your Perfect Protection,

bayts.s: وَارْحَمْنِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيَّ فَلَا أَهْلِكُ وَأَنْتَ ثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي.
t: and have mercy upon me with Your Power over me, so that I may not perish while You are my Reliance and my Hope.

bayts.s: يَا غِيَاثَ الْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ.
t: O the Saviour of those who seek help.

bayts.s: يَا دَرْكَ الْهَالِكِينَ.
t: O the Saviour of those that are going to be destroyed.

bayts.s: اكْفِنِي شَرَّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ يَطْرُقُ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ، إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
t: Suffice me against every nocturnal visitor that approaches me during the day or night except that visitor that approaches me with goodness. Indeed, You are capable of all things.

bayts.s: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِي نَفْسِي مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يُؤْذِي وَمِنْ كُلِّ حَاسِدٍ؛
t: In the Name of Allāh, I safeguard myself through incantation (ruqyah) from whatever causes harm, and from every envious person;

bayts.s: اللَّهُ شِفَائِي؛ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَقَيْتُ.
t: so Allāh is my cure. In the Name of Allāh, I safeguard myself.

bayts.s: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ؛ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي،
t: O Allāh! The Lord of mankind, remove and cure all illnesses; for You are the One that cures;

bayts.s: وَعَافِ أَنْتَ الْمُعَافِي؛ لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ؛ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا وَلَا أَلَمًا.
t: and restore health, for You are the One who restores health; there is no cure, but Your Cure. A cure that leaves behind no trace of illness and no pain;

bayts.s: يَا كَافِي يَا وَافِي يَا حَمِيدُ يَا مَجِيدُ، ارْفَعْ عَنِّي كُلَّ تَعَبٍ شَدِيدٍ،
t: O the Self-Sufficient, O the Fulfiller, O the Praised One, O the Glorious, remove from me extreme exhaustion;

bayts.s: وَاكْفِنِي مِنَ الْحَدِّ وَالْحَدِيدِ، وَالْمَرَضِ الشَّدِيدِ، وَالْجَيْشِ الْعَدِيدِ،
t: suffice me against all injurious instruments, severe illnesses and the impending threat (from armies).

bayts.s: وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا مِنْ نُورِكَ، وَعِزًّا مِنْ عِزِّكَ، وَنَصْرًا مِنْ نَصْرِكَ،
t: Grant me a light from Your Light, honour from Your Honour, victory from Your Victory,

bayts.s: وَبَهَاءً مِنْ بَهَائِكَ، وَعَطَاءً مِنْ عَطَائِكَ، وَحِرَاسَةً مِنْ حِرَاسَتِكَ، وَتَأْيِيدًا مِنْ تَأْيِيدِكَ.
t: magnificence from Your Magnificence, a gift from Your Gifts, a guard from Your Guards, and a support from Your Support.

bayts.s: يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، وَالْمَوَاهِبِ الْعِظَامِ،
t: O Lord of Sublimity and Honour, and Magnificent Gifts.

bayts.s: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَكْفِيَنِي مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْأَكْبَرُ.
t: I beseech You to suffice me against the evil of those who cause evil; Verily, You are Allāh, the Creator, the Great.

bayts.s: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ،
t: And may the Blessings and abundant good, and Blessed Peace of Allāh be upon our master Muḥammad, and upon his family and his Companions.

bayts.s: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ظَاهِرًا وَبَاطِنًا وَعَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
t: And Praise be to Allāh, Lord of the Worlds, openly and secretly, and at all times; O the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

bayts.s: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي.
t: I seek forgiveness from Allāh; there is no god but Him, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, Who never dies; I repent to Him, O Lord forgive me.

bayts.s: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ.
t: I ask Allāh’s Forgiveness for all believing men and women.
